s: Distributed inverted-index engine delivering full-text relevance, facets, and log exploration at interactive speeds.
w: Documents tokenize into inverted indexes; BM25 scores relevance. Indices shard across nodes, replicas serve HA/read scaling. Near-real-time refresh makes writes searchable in ~1s. Aggregations power faceting/analytics. Cluster state in master-elected nodes; shard balancing automatic.
use: Product/content search with relevance tuning (synonyms, boosts, fuzzy)
Log analytics (ELK stack) with Kibana dashboards
Faceted navigation (filters by brand/price/category computed instantly)
avoid: System-of-record duty (it's a derived index - source elsewhere)

pat.d: DB is truth; CDC feeds ES; queries hit ES only.

pits: Shard explosion from over-sharding small indices - right-size (target 10-50GB/shard)
Deep pagination kills clusters - use search_after/cursors
Mapping explosions on dynamic fields - lock mappings explicitly
tips: Explain inverted index vs B-tree lookup distinction crisply
Mention OpenSearch fork landscape when relevant commercially
